stage0035_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$アムロ$$
「... Zeta and the $$νガンダム$$ aren't coming?」

stage0035_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Londo Bell HQ is working on it too,
　but the odds look slim.」

stage0035_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$チェーン$$
「I've been using my own old contacts too,
　tracking down where those two machines went,
　but it seems Anaheim's meddling has them sealed.」

stage0035_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Is it because they're Newtype-only Gundams?」

stage0035_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$ブライト$$
「That's likely.
　The Earth supremacists running HQ
　despise the very idea of Newtypes.」

stage0035_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$チェーン$$
（I've heard this before...
　after the $$一年戦争$$, people who feared Newtypes
　kept Captain $$アムロ$$ under house arrest for ages...）

stage0035_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$アムロ$$
「But that doesn't add up.
　If those people are in league with Anaheim,
　how do you explain the Unicorn's existence?」

stage0035_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$チェーン$$
「That's true.
　The Unicorn is practically made of
　nothing but Psycoframe, after all.」

stage0035_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$ブライト$$
「So the ones who built a new Newtype-only
　Gundam sealed the other machines away
　to sell their own unit's edge...?」

stage0035_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$アムロ$$
「But then that would contradict
　the Earth supremacist link from before.」

stage0035_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$チェーン$$
「Anaheim isn't a monolith either.
　Especially lately, the $$マーサ・ビスト・カーバイン$$
　faction seems to be making its own moves.」

stage0035_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$アムロ$$
「$$アルベルト$$'s aunt, is she...
　So the Unicorn came out of that too.」

stage0035_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$ブライト$$
「For the Gundam, I'll try a roundabout way.」

stage0035_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$ブライト$$
「I'll have $$ベルトーチカ$$ reach out to Luio & Co.
　They should find a gap in Anaheim's defenses.」

stage0035_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$ブライト$$
「A former member of 《$$カラバ$$》.
　A woman who still remains on Earth,
　supporting Londo Bell.」

stage0035_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$ブライト$$
（It's a personal matter.
　Better not to say it, especially in front of $$チェーン$$.）

stage0035_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I understand the situation.
　...If possible, prioritize the Zeta.」

stage0035_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Worried about $$カミーユ$$, are you...」

stage0035_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$アムロ$$
「He's even more attached to $$シャア$$ than I am.
　At this rate it'll start hurting $$バナージ$$ too.」

stage0035_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$ブライト$$
「But judging by the fighting so far,
　Neo Zeon seems to see some kind of
　significance in that Unicorn unit.」

stage0035_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$ブライト$$
「They might target it
　and come at us because of that.」

stage0035_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$アムロ$$
「'Nothing ventured, nothing gained,' they say...
　Maybe it's time we made a move too.」

stage0035_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$ブライト$$
「No time to deal with the stowaway $$ユノハ$$ found.」

stage0035_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I'll leave that to Colonel Katsuragi and Miss $$スズネ$$.」

stage0035_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I checked with $$聖天使学園$$ about you,
　and it's confirmed you're an Element candidate.」

stage0035_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$ジン$$
（Of course.
　Hacking into a computer that basic
　and rewriting a student's data was nothing.）

stage0035_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$ミサト$$
「You got curious about the Aquarion
　you were slated to pilot, boarded the
　$$ネェル・アーガマ$$, and ended up in space... so it goes.」

stage0035_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$スズネ$$
「This is an emergency.
　I'm sorry, but we don't have the time
　or the means to send you back to Earth.」

stage0035_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$ミサト$$
「So as a special exception,
　you'll continue on with us as an
　Element candidate, just as you are.」

stage0035_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$ジン$$
（With this, the plan's basically a success.
　All that's left is to find the strongest
　$$レア・イグラー$$ among them, and the game is cleared.）

stage0035_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$ジン$$
（So this is... a real, live $$レア・イグラー$$...
　What a nice smell...）

stage0035_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$ジン$$
（N-no good...!
　This makes me just like $$カグラ$$...!）

stage0035_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$ミサト$$
「You'd look cuter with parted bangs, you know.」

stage0035_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Now then, Akbarjin...
　come along, I'll introduce you to everyone.」

stage0035_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Starting today, he'll be fighting
　alongside all of you. This is Akbarjin Badbayar.」

stage0035_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$ミサト$$
（Miss $$スズネ$$... you really remembered his name...）

stage0035_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$スズネ$$
（Kids' names these days are so hard.
　It's the result of a lot of practice.）

stage0035_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Now then, Akba... Akbal... Akbarjin.
　Say hello to everyone.」

stage0035_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$ジン$$
（Parting my bangs wasn't because
　some nice-smelling $$レア・イグラー$$ told me to...
　Acting defiant would just hinder the mission.）

stage0035_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Think he's into holes, that guy?
　Hope he is!」

stage0035_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I don't think there's really anyone like that...」

stage0035_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$葵$$
「True.
　He seems like a bit of a shy, naive type.」

stage0035_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「Definitely the submissive type! Submissive!
　But what if he's secretly the pushy type?
　No way...!」

stage0035_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$サザンカ$$,
　knock off the vulgar talk in front of $$シンジ$$.」

stage0035_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$サザンカ$$
（But how does $$アルト$$ even
　know about that kind of stuff...）

stage0035_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「I just hope our boys don't rub off on him weirdly...」

stage0035_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Now then, Akbarjin...
　as a trainee, for the time being
　you'll help out the chores crew.」

stage0035_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Now then, $n...
　I'll leave the rest to you.」

stage0035_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$アルト$$
「Good luck, Volunteer Club vice president.」

stage0035_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$n
「... All right, everyone...
　we're starting on peeling potatoes for dinner now.」

stage0035_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Huh...?
　Wasn't $$アルト$$ on kitchen duty today...?」

stage0035_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$シン$$
「That $n guy...
　took $$アルト$$'s bait and bet the duty
　on a simulation match.」

stage0035_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$宗介$$
「As you can see.
　$$アルト$$ swept three straight wins, and
　$n became potato peeling leader.」

stage0035_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$n
「$$シン$$... that weapon combo
　you taught me didn't work at all.」

stage0035_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$シン$$
「Don't ask the impossible!
　A VF-25 in space, let alone against
　$$アルト$$... combos were never landing.」

stage0035_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$n
「... A loss is a loss.
　Let's just get these potatoes done.」

stage0035_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Whatever, but seriously,
　why are us pilots cooking in the hangar?」

stage0035_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$シンジ$$
「From what Miss $$スズネ$$ said,
　the $$ラー・カイラム$$'s auto-cooker
　isn't working right.」

stage0035_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$シンジ$$
「So since we needed somewhere big enough
　for everyone at once, we ended up in the hangar.」

stage0035_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$宗介$$
「$$アンディ$$... can't you peel potatoes
　with your Element ability?」

stage0035_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Never heard of anyone doing that...」

stage0035_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Yeah, Akba... Ak... $$ジン$$!
　$$ジン$$'s fine, right!?」

stage0035_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Anyway, $$ジン$$...
　what's your Element ability?
　Any use for peeling potatoes?」

stage0035_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Cut it out, $$アンディ$$.
　$$ジン$$'s still a candidate, so
　his ability's probably still in training.」

stage0035_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$n
「That's the idea, $$アンディ$$.
　Give it up and do it by hand.」

stage0035_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$n
「We'll work in pairs.
　$$バナージ$$ with $$オードリー$$, $$アマタ$$ with $$アンディ$$,
　$$カツ$$ with $$ハサウェイ$$, $$ギミー$$ with $$ダリー$$...」

stage0035_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$n
「$$宗介$$'s with me, and $$ジン$$ pairs with $$シンジ$$.」

stage0035_03:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$ギミー$$
「That's weird... duty's supposed to be an even number...」

stage0035_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$ダリー$$
「I think... the other one is $$カミーユ$$.」

stage0035_03:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$アンディ$$
「That jerk...!
　He skipped out on duty!」

stage0035_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$シン$$
「It's fine.
　$$カミーユ$$ seems to be feeling off lately.」

stage0035_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$シン$$
「It's fine, really.
　I'll just peel twice as many potatoes myself.」

stage0035_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Well then, let's get started, $$オードリー$$.
　...Though this is my first time peeling anything.」

stage0035_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$オードリー$$
「No need to worry, $$バナージ$$.
　I've... gotten better at this kind
　of work, so I'll show you how it's done.」

stage0035_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$カツ$$
「$$ハサウェイ$$, until you leave the ship
　you're part of the chores crew too, so work hard.」

stage0035_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$ダリー$$
「Let's do our best, $$ハサウェイ$$.」

stage0035_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$ギミー$$
「Since we're at it, $$ハサウェイ$$!
　Let's have a potato-peeling contest!」

stage0035_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$n
「Just so I know, $$宗介$$...
　Have you ever peeled a potato before?」

stage0035_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$宗介$$
「I am used to handling a knife」

stage0035_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$n
「Your opponent's not an enemy, it's a potato」

stage0035_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$n
「...Survival basics: eat anything.
　Throwing away the skin isn't an option」

stage0035_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$宗介$$
「So that makes you an amateur too...」

stage0035_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$アマタ$$
「What are you doing, $$アンディ$$!
　The potato's full of holes!」

stage0035_03:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Damn it!
　Digging Force isn't cut out for peeling!」

stage0035_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$ジン$$
（What is with these people...
　Did $$カグラ$$ and I really lose to guys like this...）

stage0035_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Is this... your first time doing this?」

stage0035_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Okay, let me try it first for a bit」

stage0035_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$ジン$$
「Keep it up, and handle my share too」

stage0035_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$シンジ$$
「$$ユノハ$$... did you come to help?」

stage0035_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「Yeah...
　And I wanted to see you too, $$ジン$$」

stage0035_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「Sorry for scaring you yesterday, $$ジン$$.
　I'm... $$ユノハ・スルール$$」

stage0035_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Amazing...
　I mean that honestly」

stage0035_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「A 52% kill rate on your first try
　at a Grade II simulation...」

stage0035_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$クェス$$
「I've gotten to mess around
　with the simulator here and there」

stage0035_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「But this isn't normal.
　$$クェス$$, you must have a gift」

stage0035_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$ナナイ$$
「So that's the girl the Colonel brought...」

stage0035_03:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$ナナイ$$
「I'm $$ナナイ・ミゲル$$.
　Director of the Newtype Research Institute」

stage0035_03:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$ナナイ$$
「$$ギュネイ$$...
　Bring her to my room in an hour.
　I'll run some tests」

stage0035_03:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$ナナイ$$
（If the Colonel's right, she could be an asset too...）

stage0035_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Amazing, $$クェス$$.
　Director $$ナナイ$$ seems to have noticed your gift」

stage0035_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「It means Commander $$シャア・アズナブル$$.
　Those of us close to him, myself included,
　slip back into calling him Colonel out of habit」

stage0035_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$クェス$$
「Hmm...
　But I... I don't like that $$ナナイ$$ person」

stage0035_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Don't say that.
　She's looked out for me too」

stage0035_03:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Just between us, there are times
　I can't tell what the Colonel's thinking」

stage0035_03:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「From what I can tell,
　he says it's for the Spacenoids, but
　he's really fighting for something more personal」

stage0035_03:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$クェス$$
「Could it be to settle things with $$アムロ$$?」

stage0035_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Maybe...
　But it's not just $$アムロ・レイ$$.
　$$カミーユ・ビダン$$, and every old comrade too」

stage0035_03:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「In short, the Colonel's just venting
　his frustrations through war」

stage0035_03:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「When someone like the Colonel loses it,
　he goes and does something outrageous」

stage0035_03:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「You need power to stop him at times like that.
　That's why I had myself made into a Newtype」

stage0035_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$クェス$$
「Hmm...
　So that's why you're indebted to $$ナナイ$$」

stage0035_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「But I learned the Institute's enhancement
　can't make me like you, $$クェス$$」

stage0035_03:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「So I... want to go out with you, $$クェス$$,
　and study you up close」

stage0035_03:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$クェス$$
「You mean you want to date me?」

stage0035_03:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Does the age gap bother you?」

stage0035_03:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$クェス$$
「You're just jealous because
　I like the Colonel, aren't you?」

stage0035_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「What are you doing in the sacred
　$$レウルーラ$$'s hangar, Enhanced Human?」

stage0035_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Personal Guard Captain $$アンジェロ・ザウパー$$」

stage0035_03:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「That's right.
　The Red Comet's Guard」

stage0035_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I don't care for that phrasing.
　Just say $$フル・フロンタル$$ plainly」

stage0035_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Still, a Personal Guard assigned to
　a body double is a strange thing」

stage0035_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Watch your mouth, Enhanced Human.
　It's the Colonel's own skill that
　effectively built today's Neo Zeon」

stage0035_03:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Even that's just riding on
　$$シャア・アズナブル$$'s legend, isn't it」

stage0035_03:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「To me, the Red Comet
　is a name fit for Colonel $$フル・フロンタル$$ alone」

stage0035_03:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Got some nerve, lapdog.
　Openly criticizing the Commander?」

stage0035_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「That's enough, both of you」

stage0035_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「It's no bad thing for young men
　to push each other to improve」

stage0035_03:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Then let me arrange
　a fitting place for the two of you」

stage0035_03:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「...Good timing.
　Sorry to ask so soon after you joined us,
　but I'll need the Lieutenant's help too」

stage0035_03:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$ブライト$$
「If you go out to the battlefield too,
　what happens to your mother and Chammy!?」

stage0035_03:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$ブライト$$
「I didn't let you play with the simulator
　so you could pull a stunt like that!」

stage0035_03:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Did you want to see $$クェス$$, $$ハサウェイ$$?」

stage0035_03:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「I'm going to bring $$クェス$$ back!」

stage0035_03:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$アムロ$$
「$$クェス$$'s overly sensitive talent
　is being exploited by $$シャア$$.
　It's no use」

stage0035_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Her talent's being enhanced,
　reduced to nothing but $$シャア$$'s tool...」

stage0035_03:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「I'll stop that myself, I swear!」

stage0035_03:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$ブライト$$
「That's enough, $$ハサウェイ$$!
　You're...」

stage0035_03:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$カツ$$
「Wait, Captain $$ブライト$$!
　I'll look after Hasa!」

stage0035_03:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$カツ$$
「Please!
　I'll protect $$ハサウェイ$$!
　So...!」

stage0035_03:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$ブライト$$
「...Don't make your mother cry」

stage0035_03:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$カツ$$
「But the situation's tougher than you think.
　...A girl convinced someone understands her...
　falls hard for him, especially an older man...」

stage0035_03:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$カツ$$
「I get it...
　Chase after a girl like that, and all
　that waits for you is grief you can't undo...」

stage0035_03:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$カツ$$
「So, no matter what...
　let's get $$クェス$$ back from $$シャア$$」

stage0035_03:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$アムロ$$
（The kids I saw in $$カツ$$ and $$ハサウェイ$$ have grown up...
　$$ブライト$$ and I barely have a role left to play...）

stage0035_03:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$アムロ$$
「...You know what I mean, don't you, $$カミーユ$$?」

stage0035_03:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「I know that already...!
　It's my fault $$バナージ$$ was taken...」

stage0035_03:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$シン$$
「I'll say it straight...!
　You're scared of Captain $$クワトロ$$'s shadow!」

stage0035_03:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$シン$$
「You're just like I used to be, letting
　Chairman 《$$デュランダル$$》 decide what's right!」

stage0035_03:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$シン$$
「You said this to me back then, $$カミーユ$$...」

stage0035_03:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$シン$$
「'You've stopped judging for yourself and are
　just drunk on someone else's idea of right...!'」

stage0035_03:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$$シン$$
「So how can you, of all people, be scared of
　Captain $$クワトロ$$'s shadow and lose sight of
　what you need to do!?」

stage0035_03:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$シン$$
「Captain $$クワトロ$$ has nothing to do with it...!
　Fight with your own will!」

stage0035_03:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$シン$$
「Then you get it, right?
　What you need to do right now.」

stage0035_03:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$シン$$
「...Sorry, Captain $$アムロ$$.
　I kind of ended up butting in...」

stage0035_03:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$アムロ$$
「It's fine, $$シン$$.
　Coming from you, it'll probably
　hit home for $$カミーユ$$ more anyway.」

stage0035_03:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$アムロ$$
「If you understand, I've got nothing more to say.
　So...」

stage0035_03:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Yes, sir...
　I'll save $$バナージ$$ with my own hands, no matter what.」

stage0035_03:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$リディ$$
「But what do we do...?
　We don't even have a clue where he was taken.」

stage0035_03:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Lt. Colonel $$ダグザ$$, where is $$バナージ$$...!?」

stage0035_03:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Where the Neo Zeon unit that took him is headed...
　Probably Palau.」

stage0035_03:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「A mineral resource satellite near Side 6.
　It's a Neo Zeon stronghold now.」

stage0035_03:r_5d8b67b5bd8ce190.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（Wait for me, $$バナージ$$...
　I will come save you, no matter what...）

stage0035_03:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh, well...
　That four-winged one, for some reason,
　seemed to go easy on the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$...」

stage0035_03:r_78d3b2a75e38d6f7.text:
$$オードリー$$
「And what does that have to do with me?」

stage0035_03:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No, no...
　It's just, something caught my interest a bit...」

stage0035_03:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$$オードリー$$
「Do you have the right to pry into
　others' hearts like that, indirectly?」

stage0035_03:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$オードリー$$
「That has nothing to do with being a robot or a human.
　Know that it's a shameful act.」

stage0035_03:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Hmm... there's definitely something here.
　When that four-winged one drew near, and just now
　when you were angry, I obtained some fine Z-Chips.」

stage0035_03:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'll add this 50 Z to the squad's stock, but
　Master $$オードリー$$ needs watching from now on...
　I'll have to try all sorts of things...」

stage0035_03:r_6be0d6139fac197c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I must try this, and I must try that too...」

stage0035_03:r_b6ca80db4741a62c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You've made quite the resolve, Master $$ハサウェイ$$.」

stage0035_03:r_432a29155221625f.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Once I knew $$クェス$$ was there,
　my body just moved on its own...
　after that, I was in the moment.」

stage0035_03:r_9f7c18d1ea1b55c9.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Master $$アムロ$$, Master $$カミーユ$$, Master $$バナージ$$,
　they were probably all like that at first, too.」

stage0035_03:r_56688ad8e41b7b42.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「To grow strong enough not to lose to them,
　it's all up to you from here, Master $$ハサウェイ$$.」

stage0035_03:r_34a510533cb8a9f5.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「I know, $$ＡＧ$$.
　I intend to do everything I can to get $$クェス$$ back.」

stage0035_03:r_1afedc9fa466f321.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Please, do be careful...
　From here on, Master $$ハサウェイ$$'s actions
　may well decide your family's fate too.」

stage0035_03:r_32b2a8ce24deeb9f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If your son were to die in battle,
　your mother would blame your father, and sister grieve.」

stage0035_03:r_c7ef92060bb8199d.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「I won't... I won't make my loved ones cry.
　And I will bring $$クェス$$ back, no matter what.」

stage0035_03:r_1be6d12f616f04e4.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's the spirit.
　Now, praying light finds Master $$ハサウェイ$$'s future...」

stage0035_03:r_80f948aeaed93de8.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Today too, full steam ahead... business, business!」
